name: Karoryfer Shinyguitar electric pickup
author: Karoryfer Samples / D. Smolken
recording: Real recorded electric guitar magnetic pickup
mapping_note: root_midi follows original SFZ pitch_keycenter (default 60 where omitted).
tuning_note: tuning_cents is measured recorded pitch offset above root_midi (positive means sharp), estimated from weighted first four harmonics 0.2-1.4 seconds after onset. To play target MIDI use rate=2**((target-root_midi-tuning_cents/100)/12). Source WAV bytes preserved unmodified.
onset_note: onset_frame marks first sample over max(0.002, peak*0.01), retaining 1.5 ms pre-attack; optional start point for tight note placement.
